verification_evidence.note: A user-supplied domain is a reference point, not independent proof. Cross-links are supporting evidence, not a guarantee.

verification_note: Search results and extracted assets are candidates, not confirmed official assets. Review and verify ownership before using them for threat detection.

trust_assessment.reason: The script can check domain matches and official-site cross-links, but cannot independently prove legal ownership or that every downloaded logo/listing is authentic.

signals.note: The reference domain must have been checked independently by the user.

signals.signal: Logo source hosted on reference domain
Social accounts cross-linked from reference website
App store listings cross-linked from reference website
Legal ownership / publisher identity independently verified

recommended_checks: Enter only a domain independently confirmed from company-owned documentation, official packaging, or trusted corporate records.
Review every logo file and confirm it matches the logo on the confirmed website.
Treat social/app links published on the reference website as supporting evidence and verify the exact profile or listing.
Check app publisher identity and developer links in the official app store listing.
Do not label an asset fully trusted until a human reviewer records the evidence and approves it.
